en.headline: Man dies after fire engulfs tin-roofed house in Fanling village
en.dek: A blaze at a metal structure in Ling Shan Tsuen early on Wednesday left one man dead and forced about 78 residents to evacuate, police and fire services said.
body: Police received multiple reports at about 4.31am on Wednesday that a tin-roofed house was on fire in Ling Shan Tsuen, Fanling. Firefighters arrived and used one hose and a breathing apparatus team, extinguishing the blaze in about 49 minutes.

A man aged about 50 to 60 was found dead inside the structure. Police said the case has been classified as a fire and is being investigated by Tai Po district crime officers, who are establishing the man's identity and the cause of death. Preliminary information indicated the fire may have been related to electrical wiring.

Thirty-six men and 42 women, together with some pets, were evacuated to safety. A 12-year-old girl on Ling Shan Road who felt dizzy was taken to North District Hospital; her condition was confirmed to be unrelated to the incident.

zh.headline: 粉嶺靈山村鐵皮屋火警 中年男子倒斃現場
zh.dek: 消防凌晨在粉嶺靈山村撲滅鐵皮屋火警，發現一名約50至60歲男子當場不治，約78名居民及寵物疏散。
body: 警方於星期三凌晨約4時31分接獲多宗報案，指粉嶺靈山村一間鐵皮屋起火。消防到場出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，約49分鐘後將火救熄。
一名約50至60歲男子被發現倒斃現場。警方將案件列為火警，交由大埔警區刑事調查小隊第一隊跟進，正調查死者身份及致死原因。初步相信火警可能與電線有關。
其間36男42女連同一批貓狗疏散至安全地方。靈山路一名12歲女童感到頭暈，被送往北區醫院治理，經查證與火警無關。
